description: Compute the third right-triangle side from exactly two measured sides, both acute angles, the right angle and area using the Pythagorean theorem. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

inputSchema.description: Exactly two measured sides of a right triangle; omit the unknown side. The hypotenuse must exceed the known leg.

a.description: Leg a in the common length unit (10^-9 to 10^9).

b.description: Leg b in the common length unit (10^-9 to 10^9).

hypotenuse.description: Hypotenuse, opposite the right angle in the common length unit (10^-9 to 10^9).

unit.description: Common length unit for every coordinate or side; area uses its square.

name: pythagorean_theorem_calculator

outputSchema.description: All sides and solvedSide, angles opposite legs a/b in degrees, area in squared length unit, unit and formula.

title: Pythagorean Theorem Calculator
